posts.body_html:
found a nice trap of hummer's hurricane creek white clone#1. I have another division of this exact plant that has produced the biggest trap I've ever seen on this clone, but I'm waiting for it to color up before snappin pix. This clone is crazy awesome to breed with too, a few of you out there have seen the results first hand. Not too many people have this clone in their collection, it's still very rare in cultivation.
